name: Road Commission and Plett Evidence Package SHA-256 Manifest.txt
description: SHA-256 manifest supplied with the evidence package. All 13 attached files listed in the manifest matched their declared hashes during intake. The manifest is an integrity record and cannot satisfy a substantive evidence request by itself.

name: EGLE Quaternary Geology at 1121 Plett.geojson
description: EGLE polygon feature for the mapped Quaternary unit at 1121 Plett Road, identified as lacustrine sand and gravel. It is regional geologic context and does not establish the local hydraulic gradient or a contaminant pathway.

name: EGLE Bedrock Geology at 1121 Plett.geojson
description: Two EGLE bedrock-geology polygon features covering the supplied area, including Saginaw Formation and Midcontinent Rift attributes. The file is retained as regional bedrock context and is not interpreted as a site-specific groundwater-flow model.

name: EGLE Wexford County Water Wells with Lithology.zip
description: Official EGLE daily Wexford County Wellogic package containing 9,273 WGS84 well records and 42,844 linked lithology rows. A spatial integrity check found 45 well records within 1,000 meters of the Census-geocoded 1121 Plett point, all with linked lithology. The files provide local well construction logs, lithology logs, screen intervals where reported, static-water levels, drillers and construction dates. Property-specific certification, coordinated elevation measurements, aquifer tests and directional flow analysis remain separate evidence needs.

name: EGLE Wellogic Wells Within 1,000 m of 1121 Plett.geojson
description: Spatial subset containing 45 unique EGLE Wellogic well points within 1,000 meters of 1121 Plett Road. All 45 records report well depth and static water level; 39 report a screen interval and only five report elevation. The derived subset is retained for local well context and does not replace certified property records, coordinated water-level measurements, aquifer testing or directional groundwater-flow analysis.

name: USGS 04121241 Clam River at Plett Road Flow Data.zip
description: USGS export for station 04121241, Clam River at Plett Road, containing one monitoring-location row and ten approved field and channel-measurement rows. The ten discrete discharge observations span June 11, 1975 through September 11, 2001 and range from 6.24 to 57.6 cubic feet per second. This sparse surface-water series is hydrologic context; it is not continuous monitoring, groundwater-gradient evidence or a PFAS result.
